prompts.01-top-view:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone environment reference image for STORMBREAK CIRCUIT V2, an original kart racer populated by chunky mischievous monsters. Cartoonish but not cutesy; match premium console kart racing visual sophistication, bold teal machinery, orange steel, cream concrete, dark basalt, restrained grass, crisp hand-painted stylized 3D materials, warm afternoon light. No franchise characters. This is practical Blender environment modeling reference, readable geometry, moderate detail, not a busy poster or toy diorama.
CRITICAL REVISION: one connected continuous closed lap, entirely on land. NO ramps, jumps, road gaps, waterfalls, spillways, water on track, bridges, elevated viaducts, road intersections, extra loops, route branches, tunnels, loops in the air, or floating road. Sea is distant scenery south of a solid quay seawall only. Road is a consistent broad 18m dark asphalt ribbon, pale solid edge lines, low red/cream rumble strips, modular cream safety walls with teal railing. Keep racing road unobstructed. Gentle 0–16 m terrain rise, roads fully terrain-supported.
MASTER SPATIAL SPEC: square-ish irregular continuous loop. Start/finish on SOUTH straight near southwestern third, driving EAST. Cream one-storey pit workshop with three teal roller doors lies just NORTH/left of starting straight, orange compact control tower immediately EAST of it. Two orange dock cranes SOUTH/right of latter half of start straight, behind safety wall on solid quay apron. At southeast end road sweeps LEFT through generous 90 degree bend and heads NORTH on eastern edge; solid basalt and grass INSIDE/left of bend, seawall OUTSIDE/right. Northeast has TEAL turbine building to the EAST/outside of road, with orange vertical exhausts, turbine fans behind grilles on side walls as scenery. Road curves WEST in front of station, follows gentle north S bends, broad west turn, western inland switchbacks, and joins seamlessly into south start straight. No roof or building blocks road from above. Station is next to road, not across it.
The native diagram is the authoritative route footprint and landmark placement. Original image is COLOR, MATERIAL AND VIBE reference only; entirely DISCARD its route geometry, water features and jumps. Four pictures in this set must depict this same place, same road, same workshop, same control tower, same cranes and same turbine building. No karts or characters or crowds so modeling surfaces are unobscured. No dense annotations or invented slogans.
VIEW 1: TRUE TOP-DOWN ORTHOGRAPHIC, camera looking vertically down, north at top, entire loop comfortably inside frame with 10 percent margin. Landscape 3:2 image. Reference image 1 is the exact flat native master layout: trace its road faithfully without inventing or removing any bend. Reference image 2 is the older vibe image only. Retain full closed track, every road join visible, all of southern straight visible including return from southwestern curve and southeastern left turn. All land is one continuous landmass with low retaining walls; no internal bodies of water. Give this overhead plan rich clean stylized environment concept-art materials and convincing modular structures, but a precise level-plan camera and almost no occlusion. Show roofs of workshop and station. Subtle small directional arrows on asphalt heading east along bottom, north on right, west along top, south on left. Single start/finish line at lower left third and compact teal/orange gantry. Exact small title in corner "STORMBREAK / TOP VIEW". All road geometry visible. No panels or insets.
